name: Ball shooter (three.js)
needs: Hands: pinch to shoot balls that bounce
status: Played on the Pixel 10 Pro XL with the glasses on 17 November 2026: started with the touchpad, a tap shoots, the balls and floor stay in place when walking (a little shaky), the picture is smooth. One picture for both eyes, no depth. The page draws its pointing line thin and white, which is hard to see against its grid.

name: Room check (Ultra XR)
needs: Shows the floor, table tops and walls the cameras found; pinch or tap throws a ball that bounces off them
status: Emulator with a made-up room: the page gets the floor, a table top and a wall, ray casts and thrown balls meet them. Pixel: the cameras found the floor of a recorded room within 0.1 m. Not yet seen in the glasses.

name: Place on your floor (three.js hit test)
needs: Hands or the touchpad: a ring follows the surface you look at, a pinch or tap leaves a cylinder there
status: A page written for phones' AR hit test, which the browser on the glasses lacks: Ultra XR answers it from the room the cameras found. Emulator only so far.

name: AR cones (three.js)
needs: Hands: pinch to place cones in the room
status: Pixel: an immersive session ran for 40 s with frames arriving steadily (started from the laptop, glasses not attached). Not yet seen in the glasses.

name: Hand cubes (three.js)
needs: Hands with finger joints, as a required feature
status: Pixel: an immersive session ran for 40 s (it requires hand tracking; started from the laptop, glasses not attached). Whether cubes appear at the fingertips has not been seen.

name: Hand tracking showcase (A-Frame)
needs: Hands with finger joints: touch and pinch things
status: Emulator: VR session, both eyes, head motion, both hands with joints and pinches reached the page. Its bright background will hide the room. Not tried on the glasses.

name: Moon Rider (rhythm game)
needs: Made for two hand controllers; hands arrive as pointers with pinch
status: Emulator: session starts with both eyes, head motion and both hands. Whether it can be played with hands instead of controllers is unknown.

name: XR dragging (three.js)
needs: Hands: point and pinch to pick shapes up
status: Does not run on the Pixel 10 yet: on this page the browser's graphics process loses its context (seen in about half of all starts and six seconds into the game), which freezes the picture. Works on the emulator.
